notes.title: Railway Islands - first update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/d6e19dde55e5f62a5bf483e159040031ab5ef385.png[/img]

[h1]Version 1.0.1 brings some improvements to the game.[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1807930/Railway_Islands__Puzzle/

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2x speed option. When the train starts moving, a new button will appear, click on it to increase the train speed option by 2x.
[*] Camera zoom option. now you can zoom in and out of the camera using the + and - keys on the keyboard or w, s, up arrow and down arrow.
[*] Position of the locomotive button, now the button that starts the train is positioned in the lower center of the screen.
[/list]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/f9b6e96159bfd3aa23228d372cb8a05e9d027021.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug fix:[/b]
[list]
[*] Music volume not saved.
[/list]


[i]Thanks to everyone who is playing. It's been amazing to read your feedback and see that you're enjoying the game, it's very gratifying! Thank you very, very much for that!

Alysson N. Moraes - Developer.[/i]

notes.title: Space Elite Force II
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/31eabe983c43ac4d1ad0f134d3da05176603e421.png[/img]

We did a significant performance optimization update on the game, in addition to fixing some bugs and also improving some features like Arcade mode. I'm not going to talk much about the technical part, I think that doesn't matter much to players, but this update basically brings the improvements listed below:

[list]
[*] Reuse of objects [Object Pool]: this is basically a technique to optimize the use of hardware during the game, with this technique, objects such as shots and explosions are reused in a way that does not generate electronic garbage, optimizing the use of the processor for example .
[*] Option to play in Cooperative mode in Arcade mode: In previous versions it was not possible to start Arcade mode in cooperative mode, leaving the second player without any improvement. In this version, there is now a choice before starting an Arcade game.
[*] Improved game controls and menu navigation.
[/list]

These were some of the most important improvements of this update, we will continue to work hard to offer the best possible support, answering your questions and making updates whenever necessary.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/

Att,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

- Improved game controls and menu navigation.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II - v 1.0.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/ed4f7f016dcead53c295761b036f26f4db48711b.png[/img]
The game now at the same difficulty level as Space Elite Force I, after receiving feedback from several players about the unbalanced difficulty. We readjusted so that he had the difficulty on the same level as Space Elite Force I.

Recruit Mode
In recruit mode, the game offers a more balanced experience, with a difficulty in the right measure and standard of the game. This mode also has checkpoints before each boss or space station, so you don't have to go through all the enemy waves after dying in a boss or space station.
[list]
[*] Start with 10 HP.
[*] Checkpoints before each boss.
[*] More balanced level of difficulty.
[*] Video of bosses and other enemies adjusted.
[*] Enemy lasers do less damage.
[*] Fast game.
[*] Elite Mode
[/list]
The elite mode is more cruel, with a higher difficulty and without checkpoints before the bosses or stations. Bosses are also tougher in this mode, making the experience more challenging and time-consuming.
[list]
[*] Start with 5 HP.
[*] No checkpoints.
[*] Higher difficulty level.
[*] Hard bosses.
[*] Enemy lasers do more damage.
[*] Gambling can take longer.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/

Thank you, your feedback is very important!
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II – v 1.0.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/ed4f7f016dcead53c295761b036f26f4db48711b.png[/img]
After receiving feedback from some players, we noticed that many were finding the game much more difficult than Space Elite Force I, making the game a little frustrating for those looking for a more casual experience with the game. After checking and doing several tests in the game, we decided to create two levels of difficulty to suit both types of players, those who want a faster and more casual experience and those more experienced who are looking for a more hardcore game. So we created the “Recruit” and “Elite” difficulty levels.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/167e8b28927008a66409d0d86c3e43ce211660fb.jpg[/img]
[h1]Recruit Mode[/h1]
In recruit mode, the game offers a more balanced experience, with a difficulty in the right measure and standard of the game. This mode also has checkpoints before each boss or space station, so you don't have to go through all the enemy waves after dying in a boss or space station.
[list]
[*] Checkpoints before each boss.
[*] More balanced level of difficulty.
[*] Fast game.
[/list]
[h1]Elite Mode[/h1]
The elite mode is more cruel, with a higher difficulty and without checkpoints before the bosses or stations. Bosses are also tougher in this mode, making the experience more challenging and time-consuming.
[olist]
[*] No checkpoints.
[*] Higher difficulty level.
[*] Gambling can take longer.
[/olist]
[h1]Conclusion[/h1]
I hope that this small change can offer the best experience for all lovers of spaceship games. Remembering that this change will not affect your saved game, you can play where you left off regardless of the level of difficulty you choose before each game. The choice of difficulty does not affect the standard waves of enemies, they are the same for both modes!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/

Thank you, your feedback is very important!
Alysson Moraes - Developer.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36483741/52c619aa59051335d6675010e23dd831de15479c.png[/img]
The new version features bugfixes and support for Linux operating systems.

[h1]Bugs resolved[/h1]
[list][*] locked arcade mode (does not generate new attack waves)
[*] 'Square button on the Playstation controller' or 'X on the Xbox controller' opening the options menu in the main menu.[/list]

[h1]Linux support[/h1]
Support for Linux was added in this version, we recommend checking the minimum requirements on the game's main page. For the game to work on the Operating System, it is necessary to have a 64-bit architecture.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/855850/Space_Elite_Force/

Att,
Moraes Studio team.

notes.title: Space Elite Force II - Update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/52c619aa59051335d6675010e23dd831de15479c.png[/img]
First game update brings some improvements to the default control settings, menu navigation and a map of the keyboard controls.

The game underwent rigorous tests in the recognition and remapping of controls, the tests were made with an Xbox One controller (Xinput) and generic Playstation 2. Some problems like starting with the inverted joystick axis have been resolved, but nothing very serious has been found.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/8b2354b8418700a6f6ba0259730d549312a7e0e1.jpg[/img]

Now, in the controls remap menu, a map of the keyboard controls will appear, if the chosen player has no control assigned to him.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/928f03fc2cd681e2698edabcbdcd82b1ff88aa8e.jpg[/img]

The navigation in side menus has also been improved, now you use buttons with 'Q' and 'E', RB and LB to navigate between the menus, this made navigation easier and easier to understand.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022534/6b0413a1eaa7f231621726a5bf93cee691da26da.jpg[/img]

[h1]We will continue to improve according to player feedback.[/h1]

[i]Att,
Alysson Moraes - Developer.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/855850/Space_Elite_Force/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1204470/Space_Elite_Force_II/
